children.name: An ILAC course with a significant Iberian component
children.desc: Courses may include (but are not limited to) the ones in the provided course list. Students may choose a different relevant ILAC course to meet the requirement with the approval of the DUS.

children.name: An ILAC course with a significant Latin American component
children.desc: Courses may include (but are not limited to) the ones in the provided course list. Students may choose a different relevant ILAC course to meet the requirement with the approval of the DUS.

children.name: Approved electives: independent study, BOSP (up to 10 units) or one outside course (up to 5 units)
children.desc:
• Language coursework. Up to 12 second-year or above Spanish language units may count towards the degree, not including conversational, oral communication, business, or medical language courses.

• Independent Study. With the approval of the Director of Undergraduate Studies, Independent Study courses may count towards the degree.

• Bing Overseas Program. Up to 10 units of pre-approved BOSP coursework may contribute to the minor.

• Coursework outside the department. One approved 3-5 unit course (5 units maximum) from outside ILAC or the Language Center.

children.name: Remaining units: second-year or higher Spanish language (up to 12 units)
At least six courses of 3 units or more

grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade.
policies: These 23 units may not be used toward any other major or minor.
reviewNotes: You take an ILAC course with a significant Iberian component and one with a significant Latin American component, then ILAC courses and up to 12 units of second-year or higher Spanish language, at least six courses of 3 units or more and 23 units in all, all letter graded. A different ILAC course for either component, independent study, BOSP courses (up to 10 units) and one outside course (up to 5 units) need the Director of Undergraduate Studies' approval and are moved in by hand. The units cannot count toward another major or minor, and AP credit is not accepted; you check those yourself.
